# Geocoding API Österreich

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/geocoding/

> Geocoding-API für Österreich: Vorwärts-, Rückwärts- und Batch-Geocoding von Adressen, Straßen, Orten, Postleitzahlen und Grundstücken, mit Beispielen.

Wandelt Adresse oder Ortsname in Koordinaten um und Koordinaten in die nächste Adresse.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s), `heavy` (30/min) · Guide: [Suche](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/search.md)

## Forward geocoding

`GET /v1/geocode`

Search over the official address register, streets, places, municipalities, districts, postcodes and parcels. Road kilometers: `B83 km 329,7`, `A1 km 41` or `L190 km 3.5` (class A, S, B or L, number, the word `km`) return the point on the road at that kilometer as `place_type` `road_ref` with `properties.road_ref` (`ref`, `km`); the index holds a point every 0.1 km on motorways, expressways and federal roads and every 0.5 km on state roads (GIP.at), the nearest one is returned, the same state road number in several states gives several hits.

Response: FeatureCollection with `place_type`, `place_name`, `center`, `geometry`, `bbox`. Always pass `types` for cheap queries.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string | ja | – | Search text (also path form `/v1/geocode/{q}.json`) |
| `limit` | query | integer (1–10) |  | `5` | 1 to 10, default 5 |
| `types` | query | string |  | – | Comma-separated result types: address, street, locality, place, district, region, postcode, poi, parcel (parcels only; input such as `KG 14105 Gst 102/3`, `14105/102/3`, `Landeck .102`), road_ref (road kilometer; input such as `B83 km 329,7`, `A1 km 41`, `L190 km 3.5`) |
| `bbox` | query | string |  | – | minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat |
| `proximity` | query | string |  | – | lon,lat; nearby matches (within about 40 km) rank ahead of distant ones that match only slightly better; exact place names stay on top; ignored when bbox is set |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode?q=Herrengasse%2013%20Wien&limit=3&types=address" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode?q=Herrengasse%2013%20Wien&limit=3&types=address", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode?q=Herrengasse%2013%20Wien&limit=3&types=address", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "query": [
    "herrengasse",
    "13",
    "wien"
  ],
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "id": "address-1234567",
      "place_type": [
        "address"
      ],
      "place_name": "Herrengasse 13, 1010 Wien",
      "text": "Herrengasse 13",
      "center": [
        16.3665,
        48.2096
      ],
      "geometry": {
        "type": "Point",
        "coordinates": [
          16.3665,
          48.2096
        ]
      },
      "properties": {}
    }
  …
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `502` | Vorgelagerter Dienst nicht erreichbar |

## Forward geocoding, Mapbox path form

`GET /v1/geocode/{q}`

Same as `/v1/geocode?q=...`; the search text is the path segment (optionally with `.json`).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | path | string | ja | – | Search text, URL-encoded |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `5` | 1 to 10, default 5 |
| `types` | query | string |  | – | Comma-separated result types: address, street, locality, place, district, region, postcode, poi, parcel (parcels only; input such as `KG 14105 Gst 102/3`, `14105/102/3`, `Landeck .102`), road_ref (road kilometer; input such as `B83 km 329,7`, `A1 km 41`, `L190 km 3.5`) |
| `bbox` | query | string |  | – | minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat |
| `proximity` | query | string |  | – | lon,lat |

**Beispiel**

## Reverse geocoding (nearest address, street, place)

`GET /v1/reverse`

Nearest features around a point, nearest first. Use `types` to restrict (e.g. `address`).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lng` | query | string | ja | – | Longitude (also `lon`, `longitude`) |
| `lat` | query | string | ja | – | Latitude |
| `radius` | query | string |  | `500` | Meters, 1 to 5000, default 500 |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `1` | 1 to 10, default 1 |
| `types` | query | string |  | – | Like geocode |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/reverse?lng=16.3725&lat=48.2085&limit=1&types=address" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js

```

## Batch geocoding (up to 1000 requests)

`POST /v1/geocode/batch`

JSON array; each item has `q` or structured `street`/`housenumber`/`postcode`/`place`, optional `types` (string or list), `limit` (1 to 10), `proximity` [lon,lat], `bbox`. Response: array of FeatureCollections in input order. Requests run in batches via Meilisearch multi-search (at most 4 in parallel).

At most 512 KB.

**Request-Body (JSON)**

```json
[
  {
    "q": "Herrengasse 13 Wien",
    "types": "address",
    "limit": 1
  },
  {
    "street": "Hauptplatz",
    "housenumber": "3",
    "postcode": "3390"
  }
]
```

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode/batch" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '[{"q":"Herrengasse 13 Wien","types":"address","limit":1},{"street":"Hauptplatz","housenumber":"3","postcode":"3390"}]' | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode/batch", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN", "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify([
    {
      "q": "Herrengasse 13 Wien",
      "types": "address",
      "limit": 1
    },
    {
      "street": "Hauptplatz",
      "housenumber": "3",
      "postcode": "3390"
    }
  ]),
});
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.post("https://api.mapx.at/v1/geocode/batch", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"}, json=[
    {
      "q": "Herrengasse 13 Wien",
      "types": "address",
      "limit": 1
    },
    {
      "street": "Hauptplatz",
      "housenumber": "3",
      "postcode": "3390"
    }
  ])
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
[
  {
    "type": "FeatureCollection",
    "query": [
      "herrengasse",
      "13",
      "wien"
    ],
    "features": [
      {
        "type": "Feature",
        "id": "address-1234567",
        "place_type": [
          "address"
        ],
        "place_name": "Herrengasse 13, 1010 Wien",
        "text": "Herrengasse 13",
        "center": [
          16.3665,
          48.2096
        ],
        "geometry": {
          "type": "Point",
          "coordinates": [
            16.3665,
            48.2096
          ]
        },
        "properties": {}
  …
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `405` | Methode nicht erlaubt |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `502` | Vorgelagerter Dienst nicht erreichbar |

# Search Box API: Suche beim Tippen

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/search-box/

> Search-Box-API für Autovervollständigung: Vorschläge beim Tippen, Details eines Treffers und Orte nach Kategorie, mit Parametern und Beispielen.

Suche mit Vorschlägen für Adressen und Orte. `suggest` beim Tippen aufrufen, danach `retrieve` für den gewählten Treffer.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s) · Guide: [Suche](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/search.md)

## Search Box: suggestions

`GET /v1/searchbox/suggest`

Like geocode, but a suggestion list without coordinates (`mapbox_id` for `/retrieve`), with category (`poi_category`, `poi_category_ids`, `maki`) and `context`. Official POIs, no OSM data.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string | ja | – | Search text |
| `session_token` | query | string |  | – | Arbitrary session id (up to 128 characters), no effect |
| `proximity` | query | string |  | – | lon,lat; same ranking as geocode, also returns the distance |
| `types` | query | string |  | – | region, postcode, district, place, locality, street, address, poi, parcel, road_ref (country, neighborhood, category have no effect) |
| `poi_category` | query | string |  | – | Comma-separated category ids (English, e.g. `pharmacy`; old German ids deprecated until 2027-05-31), see `/v1/searchbox/list/category` |
| `bbox` | query | string |  | – | minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `5` | 1 to 10, default 5 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=Stephansdom&proximity=16.3725,48.2085&limit=3" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=Stephansdom&proximity=16.3725,48.2085&limit=3", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/searchbox/suggest?q=Stephansdom&proximity=16.3725,48.2085&limit=3", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "suggestions": [
    {
      "name": "Stephansdom",
      "mapbox_id": "poi-4711",
      "feature_type": "poi",
      "place_formatted": "Place of worship, Wien",
      "poi_category": [
        "place_of_worship"
      ]
```

# Adress-Autofill und Adressprüfung API

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/address/

> Adress-Autofill für Formulare und Adressvalidierung gegen das amtliche österreichische Adressregister: Endpunkte, Parameter und Beispiele.

Autofill vervollständigt eine Postadresse beim Tippen. Die Validierung prüft eine Adresse gegen das amtliche Register.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s) · Guide: [Suche](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/search.md)

## Address Autofill: suggestions

`GET /v1/autofill/suggest`

Official address register only (BEV). Completes street, house number, postcode and place; fields separated in `suggestions[]`.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string | ja | – | Partial input, e.g. `Hauptpl 3 Mel` |
| `session_token` | query | string |  | – | Session id (1 to 64 characters), echoed back |
| `proximity` | query | string |  | – | lon,lat, prefers near addresses |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `5` | 1 to 10, default 5 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/autofill/suggest?q=Herrengasse%2013%20Wien&limit=3" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js

const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**


## Address Validation (free text or structured)

`GET /v1/address/validate`

Checks an address against the official register. `status`: match | corrected | ambiguous | not_found. Returns the normalized address, `confidence` (0 to 1), `deviations[]` per field (kind: spelling | wrong | added), coordinate, `id` and `adrcd`. Understands Str./Straße, abbreviations, umlauts and ß.

`ambiguous` returns `candidates[]` (up to 5) instead of `address`.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string |  | – | Free text, e.g. `Hauptstr. 12a, 3390 Melk` (or structured fields) |
| `street` | query | string |  | – | Street |
| `housenumber` | query | string |  | – | House number |
| `postcode` | query | string |  | – | Postcode |
| `place` | query | string |  | – | Place |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/address/validate?q=Herrengasse%2013,%201010%20Wien" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/address/validate?q=Herrengasse%2013,%201010%20Wien", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/address/validate?q=Herrengasse%2013,%201010%20Wien", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "status": "corrected",
  "confidence": 0.93,
  "address": {
    "street": "Hauptstraße",
    "housenumber": "12a",
    "postcode": "3390",
    "place": "Melk"
  },
  "deviations": [
    {
      "field": "street",
      "kind": "spelling"
    }
  ],
  "id": "address-1234567",
  "coordinates": [
    15.33,
    48.23
  ]
}
```

# Routing-API: Routen, Isochronen, Matrix

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/directions/

> Routing-API für Österreich: Routen für Auto, Lkw, Rad und Fuß, Isochronen, Fahrzeitmatrizen und Map Matching, mit Parametern und Beispielen.

Routing auf dem österreichischen Straßengraphen (GIP.at). Profile: `driving`, `driving-traffic`, `driving-truck`, `cycling`, `cycling-mtb`, `walking`.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `route` (5/s), `heavy` (30/min) · Guide: [Navigation](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/navigation.md)

## Speed limits (GIP.at, statutory limits only)

`GET /v1/speedlimits`

Statutory speed limits of the road network as compact GeoJSON, either inside a box (`bbox`, at most 0.08 square degrees, about 28 x 28 km) or in a corridor around a route (`corridor` as polyline6, e.g. `routes[].geometry` with `geometries=polyline6`, plus `buffer` in meters).

One LineString feature per road link in digitizing direction with `limit_kmh`, `direction` (`both`, `forward` or `backward` relative to the geometry) and `id` (GIP link id); if the directions differ there is one feature per direction. Only statutory limits (5, 10, 20 ... 130 km/h, including the default limits inside built-up areas and on rural roads) are returned. Links without a value (many motorways) and modeled speeds such as 53 or 84 km/h are left out. At most 60,000 features. Source: GIP.at (CC BY 4.0).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bbox` | query | string |  | – | minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat in degrees, at most 0.08 square degrees; instead of corridor |
| `corridor` | query | string |  | – | Route as polyline6 (at most 20,000 points); instead of bbox |
| `buffer` | query | string |  | `30` | With corridor only: meters around the route, 1 to 500, default 30 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/speedlimits?bbox=15.325,48.225,15.335,48.23" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/speedlimits?bbox=15.325,48.225,15.335,48.23", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/speedlimits?bbox=15.325,48.225,15.335,48.23", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "legal_only": true,
  "attribution": "Datenquelle: GIP.at - Graphenintegrations-Plattform, CC BY 4.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "geometry": {
        "type": "LineString",
        "coordinates": [
          [
            15.3294,
            48.2272
          ],
          [
            15.3301,
            48.2275
          ]
        ]
      },
      "properties": {
        "limit_kmh": 50,
        "direction": "both",
        "id": 1543486
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

| Feld | Typ | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|
| `legal_only` | boolean | always true: only statutory limits are listed |

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `502` | Vorgelagerter Dienst nicht erreichbar |

## Corridor graph for offline rerouting

`GET /v1/corridor-graph`

Compact binary subgraph of the road network around a route, for recomputing a route without network (for example in a dead zone after a wrong turn). `polyline` is the route as polyline6 (e.g. `routes[].geometry` with `geometries=polyline6`), `buffer` the radius around it in meters (default 3000, at most 5000).

The response body is a gzip stream (`application/vnd.mapx.corridor-graph+gzip`, no `Content-Encoding`) of a `MXCG` v1 file: a version header and the graph id of the server graph, nodes (microdegrees), directed arcs with travel time and weight in ms (the same values the router uses, so offline costs equal server costs), simplified link geometry, road name and reference, road class (FRC/FOW), maximum speed with a statutory flag, link flags (roundabout, ramp, toll, urban, motorway) and the turn restrictions between the arcs including derived U-turn bans. Arcs that cannot be driven are left out. Typically 1 to 3 MB per 100 km of route (compressed). Source: GIP.at (CC BY 4.0).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `polyline` | query | string | ja | – | Route as polyline6 (at most 20,000 points) |
| `profile` | query | string |  | – | driving (default), cycling or walking |
| `buffer` | query | string |  | `3000` | Meters around the route, 100 to 5000, default 3000 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/corridor-graph?polyline=_wp~zAofsf%5C_nDouS_pR_af@&buffer=1000" -o result.bin
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/corridor-graph?polyline=_wp~zAofsf%5C_nDouS_pR_af@&buffer=1000", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const blob = await res.blob();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/corridor-graph?polyline=_wp~zAofsf%5C_nDouS_pR_af@&buffer=1000", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
open("result.bin", "wb").write(res.content)
```

**Beispielantwort**: `application/vnd.mapx.corridor-graph+gzip` · Corridor graph (gzip of MXCG v1)

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `404` | Nicht gefunden (Name, Pfad oder Position) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `502` | Vorgelagerter Dienst nicht erreichbar |

## Routing

`GET /v1/directions/{profile}/{coordinates}`

Trucks (`driving-truck`, over 3.5 t): vehicle size via `weight`, `height`, `width`, `length`, `truck_type`; roads are blocked per vehicle (weight-class, semi and trailer bans, height/width/weight/length limits). Truck speeds: at most 80 km/h on motorways, 70 on rural roads, 50 in built-up areas.

District-wide bans (free-text ordinances) are not routed; affected roads appear as `steps[].notices[]` (`type: truck_restriction`). Responses add `routes[].truck` (the vehicle used) and `routes[].toll.truck_go_km` (kilometers subject to the GO toll; per step `truck_go_m`). 2 to 25 coordinates; legs are computed individually. Car routes (`driving`) contain `routes[].toll` (vignette and special-toll data), `toll_road`, `toll_road_m` and `steps[].intersections[].classes`; toll source ASFINAG, CC BY 4.0. From the GIP, steps additionally carry `ref`, `destinations`, `milestone`, `maxspeed`, `ascent_m`, `descent_m` and (cycling/walking) `grade_pct`, for cycling and cycling-mtb also `bike_infrastructure` (cycleway, lane, shared, none) and `surface` (paved, cobblestone, unpaved, offroad, unknown); `routes[].summary` has ascent, descent, max grade and elevation range. The default `overview=simplified` returns a simplified geometry, `steps=true` adds step geometry and intersections. Closures: `driving` and `driving-traffic` avoid binding full closures from the traffic reports (EVIS/ASFINAG) and list them in `routes[].closures_avoided`; `driving` without active closures along the route is unchanged. Navigation: `steps=true` with `voice_instructions=true` and/or `banner_instructions=true` adds Mapbox-style voice and banner instructions (all road profiles, texts in `language`). Speed limits: `maxspeed` (step and annotation) is `{speed, unit, legal}`; `legal: true` marks a statutory limit (5, 10, 20 ... 130 km/h), `legal: false` a modeled GIP speed (e.g. 53, 84) that is not a limit; `{unknown: true}` without a value (backward compatible: `speed` and `unit` are unchanged). For limits along a corridor see `/v1/speedlimits`.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | path | string | ja | – | driving, driving-traffic (with current traffic and closures), driving-truck (trucks over 3.5 t; vehicle size via weight/height/width/length/truck_type), cycling, cycling-mtb or walking (`mapbox/` prefix allowed) |
| `coordinates` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat;lon,lat;... |
| `steps` | query | string |  | – | true for turn-by-turn steps (with maneuvers and intersections) |
| `geometries` | query | string |  | – | geojson (default) \| polyline \| polyline6 |
| `overview` | query | string |  | – | simplified (default, simplified route geometry), full (every vertex) or false (no geometry) |
| `language` | query | string |  | – | de (default) or en |
| `alternatives` | query | string |  | – | true (up to 2), false or 0 to 3; only with exactly 2 coordinates. Alternatives are built via laterally offset waypoints and appear as additional `routes[]` |
| `annotations` | query | string |  | – | duration, distance, speed, maxspeed, elevation, weather_warnings (comma-separated; `weather_warnings` adds `routes[].weather_warnings`, the official warnings whose area the route crosses, without geometry): `legs[].annotation` per geometry segment; speed in m/s, maxspeed `[{speed, unit: km/h, legal} \| {unknown: true}]` (driving only; `legal` is true for a statutory limit and false for a modeled speed such as 53 or 84 that must not be shown as a limit), elevation = mean segment height in m |
| `radiuses` | query | string |  | – | Search radius per coordinate in meters, semicolon-separated, or `unlimited` |
| `approaches` | query | string |  | – | unrestricted or curb per coordinate (validated, not yet used by the router) |
| `bearings` | query | string |  | – | degrees,tolerance per coordinate (validated, not yet used by the router) |
| `incidents` | query | string |  | `true for driving-traffic` | true/false: traffic incidents along the leg as `legs[].incidents`; default true for driving-traffic, otherwise false; cars only |
| `exclude` | query | string |  | – | motorway, toll and/or ferry, comma-separated: `motorway` avoids motorways (category A; driving, driving-traffic, driving-truck); `toll` avoids all toll roads: vignette-required ASFINAG motorways and expressways (categories A and S) and special-toll sections (A9 Gleinalm/Bosruck, A10 Tauern/Katschberg, A11 Karawanken, A13 Brenner, S16 Arlberg; same profiles). Simplification: the vignette-free motorway sections (e.g. A1 Walserberg to Salzburg Nord, A12 at Kufstein, A14 Hörbranz to Hohenems) are avoided too, because the road graph (GIP) has no vignette attribute; with toll the route reports `toll.vignette_m` 0, and if no toll-free route exists the request fails instead of falling back to a toll route; `ferry` closes all ferry links (all profiles except driving-traffic, which returns 400). With `ferry` the route is computed without contraction hierarchies, so it takes some tens of milliseconds longer |
| `voice_instructions` | query | string |  | – | true: `steps[].voiceInstructions` (Mapbox form with announcement and ssmlAnnouncement, language per `language`); requires steps=true; all road profiles (driving, driving-truck, cycling, cycling-mtb, walking), with shorter announcement distances on foot (100 m, 40 m) and by bike (250 m, 80 m) |
| `banner_instructions` | query | string |  | – | true: `steps[].bannerInstructions` (Mapbox form, primary/secondary with text and components; destination signage and road number); requires steps=true; all road profiles |
| `cycling_surface` | query | string |  | – | any (default), cycling only; paved (close unpaved sections completely) is currently unavailable and returns 400 |
| `weight` | query | string |  | `40` | driving-truck only: gross weight in t (default 40, 0.5 to 60); avoids weight-class bans and weight limits |
| `height` | query | string |  | `4` | driving-truck only: vehicle height in m (default 4, 1.5 to 5); avoids height limits |
| `width` | query | string |  | `2` | driving-truck only: vehicle width in m (default 2.55, 1 to 3.5) |
| `length` | query | string |  | – | driving-truck only: vehicle length in m (2 to 40); length limits are only checked when given |
| `truck_type` | query | `semi` \| `rigid` \| `trailer` |  | – | driving-truck only: semi (articulated lorry, default), rigid (lorry without trailer) or trailer (lorry with trailer) |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/driving/16.3725,48.2085;15.3294,48.2272?steps=false&overview=simplified" | jq
```

## Isochrones

`GET /v1/isochrone/{profile}/{coordinate}`

Reachable areas, largest first; `properties.contour/color/opacity`. Zone `heavy`. Profile `transit` computes walking plus public transport (GTFS timetable, RAPTOR): walk to stops, ride from `depart_at`, walk on from every stop reached; only `contours_minutes` (default 5,10,15, at most 120 min), the timetable's validity period applies (otherwise 422), `metadata` carries `depart_at`, `transit_stops` and `attribution`.

`access=foot|bike|car` (default `foot`) chooses how the first stop is reached: `bike` = Bike & Ride (bike to any stop, +2 min for locking), `car` = Park & Ride (drive, at most 25 min, to stops with rail/metro/tram service, +3 min for parking, and to official GIP P+R sites, +2 min and a walk to the stop); the fastest combination wins, exit is always on foot. `park=official` restricts parking to official P+R/B+R sites. `metadata` then adds `access`, `park`, `access_stops_improved` and `access_sites` (top `sites` entries: `source` site|stop, `kind`, `name`, `lon`, `lat`, `arrive_min`, `ready_min`, `stops_won`). Bike carriage on trains is not in the timetable data, so there is no `egress=bike`. The other profiles reject `depart_at`, `access` and `park` (400).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | path | string | ja | – | driving, driving-traffic, driving-truck, cycling, cycling-mtb, walking or transit (walking plus public transport from `depart_at`); `mapbox/` prefix allowed |
| `coordinate` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat |
| `contours_minutes` | query | string |  | `5` | Up to 4 values, comma-separated (default 5,10,15) |
| `contours_meters` | query | string |  | – | Distances instead of minutes (not for `transit`) |
| `depart_at` | query | string |  | `now` | Only `transit`: departure, ISO 8601 local time Europe/Vienna without offset (`2026-11-10T08:00`), or with `Z`/offset, or Unix seconds; default now |
| `access` | query | string |  | – | Only `transit`: foot (default) \| bike (Bike & Ride) \| car (Park & Ride) |
| `park` | query | string |  | `bike every stop` | Only `transit` with bike/car: any (default: bike every stop, car rail stops) \| official (only official P+R/B+R sites) |
| `sites` | query | string |  | `10` | Only `transit` with bike/car: number of access entries in `metadata.access_sites` (default 10, max 50) |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/isochrone/walking/16.3725,48.2085?contours_minutes=5,10,15" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js

const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python

data = res.json()
```

## Travel time / distance matrix

`GET /v1/matrix/{profile}/{coordinates}`

2 to 25 coordinates. `sources`/`destinations` as index list (`0;2`) or `all`.

| `coordinates` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat;lon,lat;... |
| `sources` | query | string |  | – | Indices, semicolon-separated |
| `destinations` | query | string |  | – | Indices, semicolon-separated |
| `annotations` | query | string |  | – | duration (default), distance or both |

## Map matching

`GET /v1/matching/{profile}/{coordinates}`

2 to 100 GPS points snapped to the road network. Longer traces: POST /match at routing.mapx.at.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | path | string | ja | – | driving, driving-traffic (with current traffic and closures), driving-truck (trucks over 3.5 t; vehicle size via weight/height/width/length/truck_type), cycling, cycling-mtb or walking (`mapbox/` prefix allowed) |
| `coordinates` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat;lon,lat;... |
| `timestamps` | query | string |  | – | Unix seconds, semicolon-separated |
| `radiuses` | query | string |  | – | Meters per point (largest value counts, 5 to 500) |
| `geometries` | query | string |  | – | geojson \| polyline \| polyline6 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash

```

## Playground

# Routenoptimierung API

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/optimization/

> Routenoptimierungs-API: beste Reihenfolge für bis zu 25 Stopps und Tourenplanung für mehrere Fahrzeuge, mit Parametern und Beispielanfragen.

Findet die beste Reihenfolge von Stopps (Handlungsreisender) oder plant Touren für mehrere Fahrzeuge mit Kapazitäten und Zeitfenstern.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `heavy` (30/min) · Guide: [Navigation](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/navigation.md)

## Optimized order

`GET /v1/optimized-trips/{profile}/{coordinates}`

2 to 25 coordinates. Exact up to 12 points, above that nearest neighbour with 2-opt and Or-opt over the duration matrix. Response like Directions: `trips[]` with one route, `waypoints[]` in input order with `waypoint_index` (position in the trip) and `trips_index`.

Expensive: zone `heavy`.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `profile` | path | string | ja | – | driving, driving-traffic (with current traffic and closures), driving-truck (trucks over 3.5 t; vehicle size via weight/height/width/length/truck_type), cycling, cycling-mtb or walking (`mapbox/` prefix allowed) |
| `coordinates` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat;lon,lat;... |
| `source` | query | string |  | – | any (default) or first (point 0 is the start) |
| `destination` | query | string |  | – | any (default) or last (last point is the end) |
| `roundtrip` | query | string |  | – | true (default) returns to the start, or false; true with destination=last needs source=first |
| `steps` | query | string |  | – | true for turn-by-turn steps |
| `geometries` | query | string |  | – | geojson\|polyline\|polyline6 |
| `overview` | query | string |  | – | simplified (default) \| full \| false |
| `language` | query | string |  | – | de (default) or en |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimized-trips/driving/16.3725,48.2085;15.6256,48.2049;14.2858,48.3069?roundtrip=true" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimized-trips/driving/16.3725,48.2085;15.6256,48.2049;14.2858,48.3069?roundtrip=true", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimized-trips/driving/16.3725,48.2085;15.6256,48.2049;14.2858,48.3069?roundtrip=true", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "code": "Ok",
  "trips": [],
  "waypoints": []
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |

## Tour planning (simplified Optimization v2)

`POST /v1/optimization`

Vehicles with start/end/capacity/time window, services (one location) and shipments (pickup before delivery, same vehicle) with duration, time windows and amounts. Heuristic: regret insertion, local search, ruin and recreate until `options.time_limit_ms`. At most 10 vehicles, 50 jobs, 60 distinct locations, 256 KB.

Times in seconds. Expensive: zone `heavy`.

**Request-Body (JSON)**

| Name | Typ | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|
| `profile` | string | driving (default), cycling, cycling-mtb or walking |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimization" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"vehicles":[{"id":1,"start":[16.3725,48.2083],"end":[16.3725,48.2083]}],"services":[{"id":1,"location":[15.6256,48.2049],"service":300},{"id":2,"location":[14.2858,48.3069],"service":300}]}' | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimization", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN", "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    "vehicles": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "start": [
          16.3725,
          48.2083
        ],
        "end": [
          16.3725,
          48.2083
        ]
      }
    ],
    "services": [
      {
        "id": 1,
        "location": [
          15.6256,
          48.2049
        ],
        "service": 300
      },
      {
        "id": 2,
        "location": [
          14.2858,
          48.3069
        ],
        "service": 300
      }
    ]
  }),
});
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.post("https://api.mapx.at/v1/optimization", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"}, json={
    "vehicles": [
      {

        "id": 1,

          48.2049
        ],
        "service": 300
      },
      {
        "id": 2,

        ],

      }
```

# ÖV-API: Verbindungen und Abfahrten

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/transit/

> ÖV-API für den öffentlichen Verkehr in Österreich: Verbindungen, Haltestellen und Abfahrtstafeln aus den Fahrplandaten, mit Parametern und Beispielen.

Verbindungen mit öffentlichem Verkehr (zu Fuß oder mit dem Rad zur Haltestelle), Abfahrtstafeln und Haltestellen auf Basis des Fahrplans.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `route` (5/s), `search` (10/s) · Guide: [ÖV-Abfahrten](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/transit.md)

## Public transit: walking plus transit (GTFS timetable, RAPTOR)

`GET /v1/directions/transit/{coordinates}`

Exactly origin and destination. Connections with walks on the GIP.at network and rides (line, stops, times). Time via `depart_at` (default now) or `arrive_by`, ISO 8601 in Vienna local time. Timetable data: OeBB-Personenverkehr AG (CC BY 4.0); data source: Mobilitaetsverbuende Oesterreich OG, data.mobilitaetsverbuende.at.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coordinates` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat;lon,lat (exactly origin and destination) |
| `depart_at` | query | string |  | – | Earliest departure, e.g. 2026-11-09T08:00 |
| `arrive_by` | query | string |  | – | Latest arrival, instead of depart_at |
| `routes` | query | string |  | `3` | 1 to 5, default 3 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/16.3725,48.2085;16.4202,48.1855?depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/16.3725,48.2085;16.4202,48.1855?depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/directions/transit/16.3725,48.2085;16.4202,48.1855?depart_at=2026-11-09T08:00", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "code": "Ok",
  "routes": [
    {
      "duration": 2400,
      "legs": [
        {
          "mode": "walking",
          "duration": 300
        },
        {
          "mode": "transit",
          "line": "S1",
          "from": "Wien Hbf",
          "to": "Wien Floridsdorf"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "waypoints": []
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `422` | Anfrage gültig, aber nicht beantwortbar (z. B. keine Route) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `502` | Vorgelagerter Dienst nicht erreichbar |

## Departure board (scheduled GTFS timetable)

`GET /v1/departures`

Next departures at a station (id from `/v1/stops`, e.g. `at:43:7226`) or at all stations around a coordinate. Service days follow calendar and feed period, trips past midnight included. Per departure: time, line (name, mode, route_type), headsign, destination, platform (null if unknown), operator, stop.

No real-time data: `realtime` is always false. Outside the feed period 422, unknown station 404. Timetable data: OeBB-Personenverkehr AG (CC BY 4.0); data source: Mobilitaetsverbuende Oesterreich OG, data.mobilitaetsverbuende.at.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stop` | query | string | ja | – | Station id (IFOPT `at:<state>:<nr>`, also platform id `at:43:7226:0:2`) or lon,lat |
| `time` | query | string |  | `now` | Start time, ISO 8601 (Vienna local) or Unix seconds, default now |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `20` | 1 to 100, default 20 |
| `radius` | query | string |  | `300` | With lon,lat only: meters, 1 to 2000, default 300 |
| `horizon` | query | string |  | `14400` | Window in seconds, 60 to 86400, default 14400 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/departures?stop=16.3725,48.2085&limit=5&radius=300" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/departures?stop=16.3725,48.2085&limit=5&radius=300", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/departures?stop=16.3725,48.2085&limit=5&radius=300", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "time": "2026-11-09T08:00:00+01:00",
  "realtime": false,
  "stops": [
    {
      "id": "at:43:7226",
      "name": "Melk Bahnhof"
    }
  ],
  "departures": [
    {
      "time": "2026-11-09T08:04:00+01:00",
      "line": {
        "name": "REX 1",
        "mode": "rail",
        "route_type": 2
      },
      "headsign": "Wien Westbahnhof",
      "platform": "2",
      "stop": "at:43:7226"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `404` | Nicht gefunden (Name, Pfad oder Position) |
| `422` | Anfrage gültig, aber nicht beantwortbar (z. B. keine Route) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `502` | Vorgelagerter Dienst nicht erreichbar |

## Stops (GTFS stations merged by IFOPT)

`GET /v1/stops`

Stations in a box (`bbox`, by number of trip patterns descending) or around a point (`near`, nearest first, with `distance` in meters). Per station `id`, `name`, `location` [lon,lat], `modes` (rail, bus, tram, subway, ...) and `lines`.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bbox` | query | string |  | – | west,south,east,north in degrees, at most 1 square degree |
| `near` | query | string |  | – | lon,lat, instead of bbox |
| `radius` | query | string |  | `500` | With near only: meters, 1 to 5000, default 500 |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `50` | 1 to 500, default 50 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/stops?near=16.3725,48.2085&radius=300&limit=5" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/stops?near=16.3725,48.2085&radius=300&limit=5", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/stops?near=16.3725,48.2085&radius=300&limit=5", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "stops": [
    {
      "id": "at:43:7226",
      "name": "Melk Bahnhof",
      "location": [
        15.3338,
        48.2279
      ],
      "modes": [
        "rail",
        "bus"
      ],
      "lines": [
        "REX 1",
        "S50"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |

# Static-Images-API: Karte als Bild

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/static-images/

> Static-Images-API: Kartenbilder als PNG oder WebP mit Pins, Pfaden und GeoJSON-Overlays für Berichte, E-Mails und Exposés, mit Beispielen.

Rendert ein Kartenbild für Ausschnitt und Größe, optional mit Overlays. Das Ergebnis ist cachebar (`ETag`).

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `heavy` (30/min) · Guide: [Statische Bilder](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/static-images.md)

## Map image (Static Images, Mapbox form)

`GET /v1/static/{style}/{view}/{size}`

`satellite` (BEV orthophoto, z5 to z18) or `outdoors` (hypsometric tints with hillshade from the DTM, z5 to z16). The `streets*` styles are rendered server-side from the style and the vector tiles (fills, lines, relief shading, place, road and water names; icons from the sprite, house numbers from z16; z0 to z22), usually under 0.2 s per 600x400.

`satellite-streets` draws the orthophoto (z5 to z18) with roads, boundaries, contours, names and icons of the vector map on top. Output PNG (default) or WebP, at most 1280x1280 (2560x2560 pixels with @2x). `Cache-Control` and `ETag` (If-None-Match gives 304).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | path | string | ja | – | streets, streets-dawn, streets-dusk, streets-night, satellite, satellite-streets or outdoors (old ids `karte`, `luftbild`, ... as deprecated alias) |
| `view` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat,zoom[,bearing] (rotation in degrees, pitch only 0) or `auto` (only with overlays, fits the extent) |
| `size` | path | string | ja | – | \{width\}x\{height\}[@2x][.png\|.webp], each 1 to 1280 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/satellite/16.3725,48.2085,15/600x400" -o result.png
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/satellite/16.3725,48.2085,15/600x400", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const blob = await res.blob();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/satellite/16.3725,48.2085,15/600x400", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
open("result.png", "wb").write(res.content)
```

**Beispielantwort**: `image/png`, `image/webp` · Image

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `304` | Nicht geändert (mit `If-None-Match`) |
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `404` | Nicht gefunden (Name, Pfad oder Position) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `503` | Daten vorübergehend nicht verfügbar |

## Map image with overlays

`GET /v1/static/{style}/{overlay}/{view}/{size}`

`overlay`: comma-separated list (at most 50, 20000 vertices) of `pin-{s|m|l}[-label]+{hex}(lon,lat)` (label not drawn), `path-{width}[+{stroke}[-{opacity}][+{fill}[-{opacity}]]]({polyline, precision 5, URL-encoded})` and `geojson({URL-encoded GeoJSON})` with simplestyle properties (stroke, stroke-width, stroke-opacity, fill, fill-opacity, marker-color, marker-size).

Example: `/v1/static/satellite/pin-s+ff0000(15.33,48.22)/15.33,48.22,15/600x400.png`

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | path | string | ja | – | streets, streets-dawn, streets-dusk, streets-night, satellite, satellite-streets or outdoors (old ids `karte`, `luftbild`, ... as deprecated alias) |
| `overlay` | path | string | ja | – | pin-..., path-..., geojson(...), comma-separated |
| `view` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat,zoom[,bearing] (rotation in degrees, pitch only 0) or `auto` (only with overlays, fits the extent) |
| `size` | path | string | ja | – | \{width\}x\{height\}[@2x][.png\|.webp], each 1 to 1280 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/streets/pin-s%2Bff0000(16.3725,48.2085)/16.3725,48.2085,14/600x400" -o result.png
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/streets/pin-s%2Bff0000(16.3725,48.2085)/16.3725,48.2085,14/600x400", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const blob = await res.blob();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/static/streets/pin-s%2Bff0000(16.3725,48.2085)/16.3725,48.2085,14/600x400", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
open("result.png", "wb").write(res.content)
```

**Beispielantwort**: `image/png`, `image/webp` · Image

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `304` | Nicht geändert (mit `If-None-Match`) |
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `404` | Nicht gefunden (Name, Pfad oder Position) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `503` | Daten vorübergehend nicht verfügbar |

# Tilequery und Parcel API

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/tilequery/

> Tilequery-API: Objekte um einen Punkt aus beliebigen Vektor-Tilesets und das Katastergrundstück an einem Punkt (Parcel-API), mit Parametern und Beispielen.

Tilequery liefert die Vektorobjekte nahe einer Koordinate. Parcel liefert das Grundstück (Fläche, Nummer, Katastralgemeinde) an einem Punkt.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s) · Guide: [Grundstücke](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/parcels.md)

## Tilequery: vector features around a point

`GET /v1/tilequery/{tilesets}/{coordinate}.json`

Reads the vector tile at the tileset's highest zoom (and neighbouring tiles for a radius). FeatureCollection, nearest feature first, `properties.tilequery = {distance (m), geometry (point|linestring|polygon), layer}`. Polygons containing the point have distance 0.

Several comma-separated tilesets add `tilequery.tileset`; `dtm`/`dsm` return the height as a point feature. Geometries are clipped to the tile.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tilesets` | path | string | ja | – | Tileset names, comma-separated (at most 15), e.g. `streets,cadastre` |
| `coordinate` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat (the path ends in `.json`) |
| `radius` | query | string |  | `0` | Meters, 0 to 2000, default 0 |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `5` | 1 to 50, default 5 |
| `layers` | query | string |  | – | Comma-separated layer names |
| `geometry` | query | string |  | – | point, linestring or polygon |
| `dedupe` | query | string |  | – | true (default) removes duplicates across tile borders |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/tilequery/cadastre/16.3725,48.2085.json?radius=50&limit=3" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/tilequery/cadastre/16.3725,48.2085.json?radius=50&limit=3", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/tilequery/cadastre/16.3725,48.2085.json?radius=50&limit=3", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "geometry": {
        "type": "Point",
        "coordinates": [
          16.37,
          48.21
        ]
      },
      "properties": {
        "name": "Herrengasse",
        "tilequery": {
          "distance": 3.2,
          "geometry": "linestring",
          "layer": "road_l"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `404` | Nicht gefunden (Name, Pfad oder Position) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |

## Parcel at a point (BEV DKM)

`GET /v1/parcel/{coordinate}`

Parcel (`parcel_number`, `cadastral_municipality_id`, `area_m2`, `is_building_land`, `source`, plus `parcel_id` and `links.dossier`; the old fields `gstnr`, `kgnr`, `bauflaeche`, `quelle` are deprecated and still present until 2027-05-31) as polygon, computed from the boundary lines of the cadastre tiles (area deviates by per mille from the register value).

Buildings return the building parcel (`parcel_number` starts with a dot). Parcels extending beyond the tile window (about 2 km) are missing. Empty list outside the cadastre data. With `include=dossier` each feature is the full dossier of `/v1/parcels/{id}` (zone cost 4 plus the dossier).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coordinate` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat or lon,lat.json |
| `radius` | query | string |  | `0` | Meters, 0 to 100, default 0 |
| `include` | query | `dossier` |  | – | `dossier` returns the full dossier per feature |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcel/15.3294,48.2272" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcel/15.3294,48.2272", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcel/15.3294,48.2272", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "geometry": {
        "type": "Polygon",
        "coordinates": [
          [
            [
              16.3721,
              48.2081
            ],
            [
              16.3727,
              48.2081
            ],
            [
              16.3727,
              48.2086
            ],
            [
              16.3721,
              48.2081
            ]
          ]
        ]
      },
      "properties": {
  …
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `503` | Daten vorübergehend nicht verfügbar |

## Parcel dossier (BEV DKM and further open data)

`GET /v1/parcels/{id}`

Everything the open data say about one parcel in one call: administrative assignment, area (`area_m2` in the plane of the Gauss-Krueger system as the cadastre computes it, `area_ellipsoidal_m2`), land use shares from the DKM, buildings (count, footprint, heights from BEV DLM where available), terrain statistics (min, mean, max elevation and mean/max slope from the terrain model, grid of up to 250 points inside the parcel), addresses assigned to the parcel, nearest public transit stop (`null` if the router is unavailable), year of the orthophoto flight, `climate` (the object of `/v1/climate/{coordinate}` at the inner point of the parcel: solar potential, normals, hot and snow days, drought; taken from a cache, sections are `null` with `status: partial` until the data of a new area are loaded), the geometry as GeoJSON and a ready-made `links.static_image`.

The ID comes from `properties.parcel_id` of parcel search results and `/v1/parcel/{coordinate}`; the form `14143-288/4` (percent-encoded slash) is accepted as well. 404 for unknown parcels, 503 while the dossier service is unavailable. Cadastre key date: see `properties.reference_date`.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string | ja | – | Parcel ID `<KG number>-<parcel number>`, `/` written as `_`, building parcels with a leading dot: `14143-288_4`, `14143-.98` |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcels/14143-288_4" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcels/14143-288_4", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/parcels/14143-288_4", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "type": "Feature",
  "id": "14143-288_4",
  "geometry": {
    "type": "Polygon",
    "coordinates": [
      [
        [
          15.3414,
          48.2191
        ],
        [
          15.3447,
          48.2191
        ],
        [
          15.3447,
          48.2227
        ],
        [
          15.3414,
          48.2191
        ]
      ]
    ]
  },
  "bbox": [
    15.3414,
    48.2191,
  …
```

| Feld | Typ | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Parcel ID: `<KG number, 5 digits>-<parcel number>` with `/` written as `_`, building parcels start with a dot, e.g. `14143-288_4`, `14143-.98` |

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `404` | Nicht gefunden (Name, Pfad oder Position) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `503` | Daten vorübergehend nicht verfügbar |

# Höhen-API: Höhe und Höhenprofil

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/elevation/

> Höhen-API für Österreich: Geländehöhe und Oberflächenhöhe für Punkte sowie Höhenprofile entlang einer Linie, mit Parametern und Beispielanfragen.

Höhe über Meer (m) für Punkte oder entlang einer Linie, aus dem Geländemodell (`dtm`) oder dem Oberflächenmodell (`dsm`).

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `elevation` (10/s), `search` (10/s) · Guide: [Höhe und Gelände](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/elevation.md)

## Elevations (bilinear from z16 Terrain-RGB, 0.1 m)

`GET /v1/elevation`

Either `points` (up to 512 points) or `path` (polyline on the sphere, split evenly by length into `samples` points). Outside the area `elevation` is null.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `points` | query | string |  | – | lon,lat;lon,lat;... (at most 512) |
| `path` | query | string |  | – | lon,lat;lon,lat;... (2 to 512 vertices) |
| `samples` | query | integer (2–1024) |  | `100` | With path only |
| `model` | query | `dtm` \| `dsm` |  | `dtm` | dtm (terrain) or dsm (surface) |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/elevation?points=12.694,47.074;15.3294,48.2272&model=dtm" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/elevation?points=12.694,47.074;15.3294,48.2272&model=dtm", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/elevation?points=12.694,47.074;15.3294,48.2272&model=dtm", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "geometry": {
        "type": "Point",
        "coordinates": [
          16.3725,
          48.2083
        ]
      },
      "properties": {
        "elevation": 171.3,
        "resolution_m": 1,
        "model": "dtm",
        "reference_date": "2025-09-15"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |

# Wetter-API: Vorhersage und Nowcast

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/weather/

> Wetter-API für Österreich: aktuelle Messwerte, Stundenvorhersage, Niederschlags-Nowcast, Warnungen und Wetterkacheln von GeoSphere Austria.

Messwerte der nächsten Stationen, Stundenvorhersage für einen Punkt und Rasterkacheln für ein Karten-Overlay. Quelle: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s) · Guide: [Karten](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/maps.md)

## Current observations of the nearest TAWES stations

`GET /v1/weather/current`

GeoSphere Austria station network, 10-minute values (temperature, humidity, wind, gust, precipitation, pressure). Nearest station first. Values come from a local cache, never fetched per request. Data source: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lon` | query | string | ja | – | Longitude (also `lng`), WGS84 |
| `lat` | query | string | ja | – | Latitude |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `3` | 1 to 10, default 3 |
| `radius` | query | string |  | `50` | Search radius in km, default 50 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/current?lon=16.3725&lat=48.2085&limit=3" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/current?lon=16.3725&lat=48.2085&limit=3", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/current?lon=16.3725&lat=48.2085&limit=3", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{

  "features": [

          16.35,

        ]
      },
      "properties": {

        "name": "Wien Hohe Warte",
        "state": "Wien",
        "altitude_m": 198,
        "distance_m": 4200,
        "time": "2026-11-08T11:50:00Z",
        "temperature_c": 9.4,
        "humidity_pct": 71,
        "wind_speed_ms": 3.1,
        "wind_direction_deg": 290,
        "pressure_hpa": 1002.1
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

## Hourly point forecast (AROME, 1 km)

`GET /v1/weather/forecast`

GeoSphere Austria model nwp-v2-1h-1km, bilinear to the point, from the current hour. Austria plus margin. Data source: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lon` | query | string | ja | – | Longitude (also `lng`), WGS84 |
| `lat` | query | string | ja | – | Latitude |
| `hours` | query | string |  | `24` | 1 to 60, default 24 |
| `ensemble` | query | string |  | – | true: add `uncertainty` (p10/p50/p90 of the ensemble for temperature, gust, precipitation) to every hour |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/forecast?lon=16.3725&lat=48.2085&hours=6&ensemble=true" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/forecast?lon=16.3725&lat=48.2085&hours=6&ensemble=true", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python

```

```json
          "p10": 8.9,
  …
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

## Precipitation nowcast for a point (15 min steps, 3 h)

`GET /v1/weather/nowcast/{coordinates}`

GeoSphere INCA nowcast nowcast-v1-15min-1km, bilinear to the point. `precipitation_starts_in_min` / `precipitation_ends_in_min` are derived from the 15-minute steps (wet from 0.1 mm/h); `null` when nothing changes within the horizon. Data source: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coordinates` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat, e.g. 16.3725,48.2085 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**


## TileJSON of weather tiles with time dimension

`GET /v1/weather/tiles/{param}.json`

param: temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, cloud, pressure, aqi, no2, o3, pm10, pm25, dust, snowlimit, sunshine, radiation, cape, snowfall (hourly, AROME) or rr_nowcast, pt_nowcast (precipitation radar nowcast, 15 min steps). `mapx:time.times` lists the available hours (UTC), `mapx:time.template` has the placeholder `{time}`; `tiles` uses `now`.

Data source: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `param` | path | string | ja | – | temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, cloud, pressure, aqi, no2, o3, pm10, pm25, dust, snowlimit, sunshine, radiation, cape, snowfall, rr_nowcast or pt_nowcast, with .json |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/tiles/temperature.json" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js

const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python

data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "tilejson": "3.0.0",
  "tiles": [
    "https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/tiles/temperature/now/{z}/{x}/{y}.png"
  ],
  "minzoom": 0,
  "maxzoom": 14
}
```

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |

## Weather raster tile (PNG 256, transparent outside the data)

`GET /v1/weather/tiles/{param}/{time}/{z}/{x}/{y}.png`

Color ramp per parameter (see legend in the TileJSON). time: `now` or a UTC hour such as `2026-11-07T20:00Z`. Data source: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `param` | path | string | ja | – | temperature, precipitation, wind, humidity, cloud, pressure, aqi, no2, o3, pm10, pm25, dust, snowlimit, sunshine, radiation, cape, snowfall, rr_nowcast, pt_nowcast |
| `time` | path | string | ja | – | now or 2026-11-07T20:00Z (nowcast: 15 min steps such as 2026-11-07T20:15Z) |
| `z` | path | integer | ja | – | 0 to 14 |
| `x` | path | integer | ja | – | Column |
| `y` | path | string | ja | – | Row, with .png |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/tiles/temperature/now/6/34/22.png" -o result.png
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/tiles/temperature/now/6/34/22.png", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const blob = await res.blob();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

open("result.png", "wb").write(res.content)
```

## Official weather warnings (GeoSphere Austria)

`GET /v1/weather/warnings`

Active and upcoming official weather warnings (up to 4 days ahead) as GeoJSON MultiPolygons in WGS84, one feature per warning (merged municipalities). `type`: wind, rain, snow, black_ice, thunderstorm, heat, cold; `level`: 1 yellow, 2 orange, 3 red; `text`, `impact` and `recommendation` carry `de` and `en`.

Fetched centrally every 5 minutes, never per request. Without `bbox` and `lon`/`lat` all warnings are returned. Data source: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lon` | query | string |  | – | Longitude: only warnings that contain the point (with lat) |
| `lat` | query | string |  | – | Latitude |
| `bbox` | query | string |  | – | west,south,east,north in degrees (WGS84): only warnings touching the box |
| `type` | query | string |  | – | wind, rain, snow, black_ice, thunderstorm, heat or cold |
| `min_level` | query | string |  | – | 1 (yellow, default) to 3 (red) |
| `active` | query | string |  | – | now: only warnings valid right now; all (default): also upcoming |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/warnings?bbox=9.4,46.3,17.3,49.1&min_level=1" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/warnings?bbox=9.4,46.3,17.3,49.1&min_level=1", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/weather/warnings?bbox=9.4,46.3,17.3,49.1&min_level=1", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

# Luftqualität API für Österreich

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/air-quality/

> Luftqualitätsindex, Schadstoffe und Saharastaub für einen Punkt in Österreich von GeoSphere Austria: Endpunkte, Parameter und Beispielanfragen.

Täglicher Luftqualitätsindex und stündlich Stickstoffdioxid, Ozon, PM10 und PM2.5 bodennah sowie die Saharastaub-Fracht für einen Punkt, aus dem Chemiewettermodell der GeoSphere (3 km). Der Index folgt dem Europäischen Luftqualitätsindex der EEA (1 gut bis 6 sehr schlecht; SO2 liefert das Modell nicht). Kartenebenen: die Wetterkacheln `aqi`, `no2`, `o3`, `pm10`, `pm25` und `dust` (siehe [Weather API](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/weather.md)). Quelle: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s) · Guide: [Karten](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/maps.md)

## Air quality index and pollutants for a point

`GET /v1/air-quality/{coordinate}`

GeoSphere chemical weather model (3 km) bilinear to the point: daily index `aqi` (3 days) and hourly NO2, O3, PM10, PM2.5 near the surface in ug/m3 with an hourly index (worst level by the EEA European Air Quality Index limits; SO2 is not provided by the model) plus the Saharan dust load (mg/m2, 0.2 degree grid).

Austria and surroundings. Data source: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coordinate` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat, e.g. 16.37,48.21 |
| `hours` | query | integer |  | `24` | 1 to 72, default 24 |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/air-quality/16.3725,48.2085?hours=6" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js

const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/air-quality/16.3725,48.2085?hours=6", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
    "lon": 16.37,
    "lat": 48.21

  "reference_time": "2026-11-08T00:00Z",
  "index_scale": {
    "1": "good",
    "2": "fair",
    "3": "moderate",
    "4": "poor",
    "5": "very_poor",
    "6": "extremely_poor"
```

# Klima-API: Sonne, Schnee, Hitzetage

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/climate/

> Klima-API für einen Punkt in Österreich: Sonnenpotenzial, Klimanormale, Hitzetage, Schnee und Dürre von GeoSphere Austria, mit Parametern und Beispielen.

Klima eines Punktes: Jahressumme der Sonneneinstrahlung und Sonnenstunden, Temperatur- und Niederschlagsnormale mit Trend, Hitze- und Frosttage, Schneetage je Winter und der Dürreindex. Quelle: GeoSphere Austria, CC BY 4.0. Dasselbe Objekt steht als `properties.climate` im [Grundstücks-Dossier](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/tilequery.md).

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s) · Guide: [Grundstücke](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/parcels.md)

## Climate at a point (solar potential, normals, heat days, snow, drought)

`GET /v1/climate/{coordinate}`

Climate of one point from open data of GeoSphere Austria: solar potential (yearly global radiation in kWh/m2 and sunshine hours, mean of the last 3 complete years, 100 m), temperature and precipitation (normal 1991-2020, last 10 years, trend, monthly normals, 1 km), hot/summer/frost/ice days and tropical nights per year, snow days per winter and the current snow depth, and the drought index SPEI (90 and 365 days, latest value with class).

Each section has `source` (dataset, cell, last day of data) and `retrieved_at`. Values are derived per grid cell and cached; the first request for a new cell fetches them from the source and can take 10 to 20 seconds (`sections` limits the work), later requests come from the cache. The same object is part of the parcel dossier (`properties.climate`). Outside Austria 404; 503 while the source is unavailable or rate limited. Data source: GeoSphere Austria (APOLIS, SPARTACUS, SNOWGRID-CL, WINFORE), CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coordinate` | path | string | ja | – | lon,lat or lon,lat.json |
| `sections` | query | string |  | `all` | Comma-separated sections to return (default: all) |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/climate/15.3294,48.2272?sections=solar,snow" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/climate/15.3294,48.2272?sections=solar,snow", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python
import requests

res = requests.get("https://api.mapx.at/v1/climate/15.3294,48.2272?sections=solar,snow", headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN"})
data = res.json()
```

**Beispielantwort**

```json
{
  "location": [
    15.3294,
    48.2272
  ],
  "status": "complete",
  "solar": {
    "period": "2023-2025",
    "years": 3,
    "global_radiation_kwh_m2_year": 1287.1,
    "global_radiation_horizontal_kwh_m2_year": 1219.1,
    "direct_radiation_kwh_m2_year": 911.6,
    "diffuse_radiation_kwh_m2_year": 375.5,
    "sunshine_hours_year": 2949.5,
    "relative_sunshine_pct": 60.3,
    "by_year": [
      {
        "year": 2025,
        "global_radiation_kwh_m2": 1310.8,
        "sunshine_hours": 2958.4
      }
    ],
    "source": {
      "provider": "GeoSphere Austria",
      "dataset": "apolis-v2-1d-100m",
      "name": "APOLIS solar radiation",
      "license": "CC BY 4.0",
      "resolution_m": 100,
      "cell_center": [
  …
```

| Feld | Typ | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|
| `location` | array | [longitude, latitude] (WGS84), optional height. |
| `status` | string | `partial`: some sections are still being loaded (parcel dossier: retry after `retry_after_s`) |
| `solar` | object,null | Solar potential: yearly sums, mean of the last 3 complete years (APOLIS, 100 m) |
| `temperature` | object,null | Air temperature (SPARTACUS, 1 km) |
| `precipitation` | object,null | Precipitation and sunshine (SPARTACUS, 1 km) |
| `temperature_extremes` | object,null | Hot, summer, frost and ice days per year, tropical nights (SPARTACUS daily data, 1 km); normal period 1991-2020 and last 10 complete years |
| `snow` | object,null | Snow cover (SNOWGRID-CL model, 1 km) |
| `drought` | object,null | Drought index SPEI (WINFORE, 1 km), latest value |

**Fehler** (Details: [Fehlerkatalog](https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/errors.md))

| Status | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `400` | Parameter fehlt oder ist ungültig |
| `401` | Token fehlt oder ungültig (`missing-token`, `invalid-token`, `token-expired`) |
| `403` | Token nicht erlaubt (`origin-not-allowed`, `origin-missing`, `pk-not-allowed`, `app-not-allowed`, `token-blocked`, `ip-not-allowed`) |
| `404` | Nicht gefunden (Name, Pfad oder Position) |
| `429` | Rate-Limit überschritten, `Retry-After` abwarten |
| `503` | Daten vorübergehend nicht verfügbar |

# Verkehrs-API: Meldungen und Tempolimits

Source: https://docs.mapx.at/de/api/traffic/

> Verkehrs-API für Österreich: Verkehrsmeldungen, Tempolimits auf Autobahnen, Anzeigen und Verkehrskacheln, mit Parametern und Beispielanfragen.

Verkehrsmeldungen (Unfälle, Baustellen, Sperren), Tempolimits auf Autobahn-Anzeigen und eine Vektorebene für Karten.

Basis-URL: `https://api.mapx.at` · Rate-Limit-Zone: `search` (10/s), `static` (5/s) · Guide: [Verkehr](https://docs.mapx.at/de/guides/traffic.md)

## Speed limits of variable message signs on motorways (GeoJSON)

`GET /v1/traffic/flow`

Edges with a sign speed limit below free-flow speed, level 0 to 3 by ratio. No area-wide traffic state (the paid source is not used). Data source: ASFINAG / EVIS.AT (CC BY 4.0), road network GIP.at (CC BY 4.0); attribution required.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |

| `bbox` | query | string | ja | – | west,south,east,north in degrees (WGS84) |


## Incident reports and traffic regulations (EVIS.AT): accidents, roadworks, closures with time span

`GET /v1/traffic/incidents`

Active reports (`active=false`: also ended and future), filterable by area, road (`road`, `road_class`), route, type and time window. Sorted by importance (closures and binding reports first, then motorways, expressways, federal and state roads, then start), paged with `limit` and `cursor` (`total`, `next_cursor`, `next` as relative URL, `next_offset`).

Roadworks on motorways and expressways carry lane details from ASFINAG (`lanes`). `mandatory=true`: binding (router: closure), show the text unchanged. Geometry along GIP edges. Data source: ASFINAG / EVIS.AT (CC BY 4.0), road network GIP.at (CC BY 4.0); attribution required.

**Parameter**

| Name | Ort | Typ | Pflicht | Standard | Beschreibung |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bbox` | query | string |  | – | west,south,east,north; optional |
| `planned` | query | string |  | – | true: planned only, false: unplanned only |
| `road` | query | string |  | – | Road number, normalized: A1, A 1 and A01 are the same; also S1, B99, L347 |
| `road_class` | query | string |  | – | Comma-separated: motorway (A), expressway (S), federal (B), state (L) |
| `active` | query | string |  | `with from/to` | false: also inactive (default with from/to) |
| `type` | query | string |  | – | Comma-separated: accident, congestion, construction, lane_restriction, road_closure, road_hazard, miscellaneous |
| `from` | query | string |  | – | Window start (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]Z): incidents still valid afterwards |
| `to` | query | string |  | – | Window end (UTC): incidents starting before |
| `route` | query | string |  | – | Route corridor: encoded polyline (like geometries=polyline6 or polyline) or GeoJSON LineString; result sorted by position on the route |
| `route_precision` | query | string |  | – | 6 (default) or 5 |
| `buffer` | query | string |  | `25` | Corridor half-width in meters, 1 to 1000, default 25 |
| `sort` | query | string |  | `with route` | importance (default): closures and binding reports first, then road class A, S, B, L, then start; route (default with route): position on the route |
| `limit` | query | string |  | `500` | At most this many features, 0 to 1000, default 500 |
| `cursor` | query | string |  | – | Page marker: next_cursor of the previous response |
| `offset` | query | string |  | – | Skip features (alternative to cursor) |

**Beispiel**

**curl**

```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" "https://api.mapx.at/v1/traffic/incidents?bbox=16.0,48.0,16.8,48.5&limit=5" | jq
```

**JavaScript**

```js
const res = await fetch("https://api.mapx.at/v1/traffic/incidents?bbox=16.0,48.0,16.8,48.5&limit=5", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } });
const data = await res.json();
```

**Python**

```python

data = res.json()
```
